name: core_command_matrix
principles: Execute with a real Discord user in the dedicated E2E guild.
Capture Discord state before and after with e2e.runner.
Verify both visible Discord effects and command response semantics.
Never infer success from an HTTP/API call alone.

cases.precondition: Dedicated test guild; management-authorized user; no assumption about school sections.
cases.action: Open /setup, select configured levels/streams for the test school, confirm the summary, then build.
cases.discord_expectation: Only resources belonging to the submitted configuration are created; managed IDs are persisted.
cases.repeat_expectation: Repeating the same build does not duplicate managed resources.

cases.precondition: A valid stored configuration exists.
cases.action: Run /build twice.
cases.discord_expectation: Second run reconciles existing managed resources instead of creating duplicates.
cases.repeat_expectation: Resource IDs remain stable when resources still match their managed identities.

cases.precondition: Stored configuration exists and selected stream is not configured.
cases.action: Add one valid stream, then repeat the same request.
cases.discord_expectation: First request adds the stream; second request reports it is already configured and does not rebuild it.

cases.precondition: A configured stream and its managed resources exist.
cases.action: Remove the stream, then rerun after introducing an unmanaged same-name resource.
cases.discord_expectation: Managed resources are removed; an unmanaged same-name resource is not selected by name discovery.

cases.precondition: The guild has a stored configuration.
cases.action: Run /status before and after a controlled reconciliation.
cases.discord_expectation: Reported state reflects the current configuration and live Discord structure.

cases.precondition: Management-authorized user and an existing academic-year state.
cases.action: Create the next valid academic year.
cases.discord_expectation: The new year becomes the active year according to command semantics and is persisted.

cases.precondition: At least one academic year exists.
cases.action: Run /years.
cases.discord_expectation: The active/inactive year history is shown without mutating server structure.

cases.precondition: At least two stored academic years exist and the user is the required owner.
cases.action: Rollback to a known prior academic year.
cases.discord_expectation: Academic-year state changes atomically from the command perspective; unrelated Discord resources are not deleted by the year rollback itself.

cases.precondition: Target member can be assigned and the selected stream exists.
cases.action: Assign the member to one stream, then assign the same member to another stream.
cases.discord_expectation: Required student/stream roles are present and conflicting student-stream assignment roles are normalized according to command semantics.

cases.precondition: Target member is not currently assigned as a student.
cases.action: Assign professor role with one gender option, then switch the gender option.
cases.discord_expectation: Exactly the applicable managed professor role remains.

cases.precondition: Selected subject channel exists and selected members are valid professors.
cases.action: Assign one or more professors to a subject.
cases.discord_expectation: Subject access is updated without converting a student into a professor or creating duplicate subject roles.

cases.precondition: Configured stream/subject exists and target member is a valid professor.
cases.action: Run the full teacher assignment path.
cases.discord_expectation: All documented managed teacher roles/access are applied consistently with the assignment operation.

cases.precondition: Managed absences channel exists and target member represents the absent teacher.
cases.action: Publish one absence announcement.
cases.discord_expectation: The announcement is posted to the managed absence channel and no extra structure is created.

cases.precondition: Configured stream exists and a valid section value 1..8 is supplied.
cases.action: Publish/update a timetable entry for a section.
cases.discord_expectation: The shared stream timetable channel contains the section-tagged timetable without creating per-section channels.

cases.precondition: Configured stream exists and a valid section value 1..8 is supplied.
cases.action: Create/update an exam entry for a section.
cases.discord_expectation: The stream exam surface is updated for the requested section according to current section-aware semantics.

cases.precondition: A student record with history exists.
cases.action: Request the student's history.
cases.discord_expectation: History is displayed without mutating Discord roles or channels.

cases.precondition: A registered student currently has managed student assignment roles.
cases.action: Mark the student as having left the school.
cases.discord_expectation: Managed student assignment roles are removed and the persisted history remains available.

cases.precondition: Management-authorized user and a configured guild.
cases.action: Open the administrative dashboard.
cases.discord_expectation: Dashboard reflects the current academic year, counts, configuration, and recent audit events.

cases.precondition: Management-authorized user in the dedicated guild.
cases.action: Run the health check.
cases.discord_expectation: Permission, hierarchy, channel-capacity, and configuration diagnostics reflect live state.

cases.precondition: Owner-authorized user; valid managed registry; dedicated E2E guild.
cases.action: Reset the managed server structure while leaving an explicitly unmanaged test resource present.
cases.discord_expectation: Only persisted managed resources are deleted; unmanaged resources survive.
